svg.title: Enterprise Platform Engineering Home Lab
svg.desc: Verified single-host Proxmox lab, BankOps delivery and public request paths, private workstation access, and separate experimental Ollama LXC.
svg.text: A small lab. A complete delivery path.
BankOps.dev / Infrastructure as code → tested images → GitOps → public HTTPS
Ubuntu Server 24.04 · 2 vCPU · 3 GiB RAM · 40 GiB disk
Optional loopback-only SSH access · separate experiment on the same physical host
NO INBOUND ROUTER PORT FORWARDING · MANAGEMENT SERVICES REMAIN PRIVATE
Single failure domain · learning lab · no HA or production-grade claim
